# Native label shape regression

This is a **schema-shaped fixture, not a captured native KB response**. The source
body and public metadata are the public Bob Horne resource captured read-only on
6 October 2026. Native `data.texts.*.value` and classifications with
`cancelled_by_user: false` model the existing `parli/arag.py` client and
`enrich/test/classify.test.ts` fixtures. No secret or credential is included.

No usable KB credentials were available in the OPAX environment files on the
Mac. A native GET capture and native dry run remain required on the refresh box
before the supervised first publication; see `docs/ROSTER-MIXUPS.md`.
